note: Khyzha & Lahav (POPL 2021): the synchronous-persist model PTSOsyn is proven equivalent, in terms of reachable states, to Raad et al.'s asynchronous-persist Px86 (POPL 2020). Full equivalence (crashes included), so not fragment_restricted; the caveat is that it is a state-based / reachable-state equivalence rather than a full trace equivalence.
